subtitles.en: Five poems mourning the destruction of Jerusalem

descriptions.en: Five acrostic poems lamenting the fall of Jerusalem and the desolation of its temple in 586 BCE. Traditionally attributed to Jeremiah, the poems combine communal grief with the affirmation that the steadfast love of God is new every morning.
